QuestInfo.name: I Need Help on My Homework!
QuestInfo.0: Whenever I walk past Wing the Fairy of Ellinia, he seems to be asking for help. I wonder what it is...
QuestInfo.1:
Wing the Fairy of Ellinia seems to have a general disdain for humans. Definitely not the kind of attitude you would expect from someone in need of help... He asks you to get him 5 Tree Branches, 10 Squishy Liquids, and 3 Slime Bubbles. He needs them to make a potion for his homework.

#i4000003:# #t4000003:# #c4000003# / 5
#i4000004:# #t4000004:# #c4000004# / 10
QuestInfo.2: I helped Wing the Fairy of Ellinia with his homework. I have no idea how that potion works, though.

0.0: Hey there, human! Do you have any time on your hands? If not, then oh well... I have something to ask you... well, not really ask, but I have a favor to ask. Are you interested...?

yes.0: There's this teacher in my Magic School that scares the bejeebus out of everyone. I mean, he's as scary as they come. Anyway, he gave us homework and we have to make a potion, but I am swamped with homework from other classes that I don't know if I can do it.
yes.1: I need #b5 Tree Branches, 10 Squishy Liquids, and 3 Slime Bubbles#k. Please get them immediately!
yes.2: What's the potion do, you ask? That's none of your business. Know this, though. If you get me the ingredients, I will reward you well for your effort. I can't stand owing something to a human.

no.0: Fine, I don't care! I can always find someone else!

1.0: Oh you got them all! I need to make this potion fast and get on with other homework. Thanks to you I think I can finish my homework. Here's a potion I made from earlier. I don't need it, so you should take it.

yes.0: I don't need you now, so please leave!

item.0: I don't think you've gathered them all up. Hurry up, I don't have much time. I have to start memorizing the spells after I'm done with the potion homework!
